data.one_liner: Global loading widget and dialog utility for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a global loading provider that allows you to show and hide loading dialogs anywhere in your app without passing a BuildContext. It supports custom loading widgets and background tap dismiss behavior.
use_when: You need a simple, global loading indicator accessible from anywhere in your app code.
You want an alternative to OKToast specifically for loading dialogs.
avoid_when: You need complex state management libraries that handle loading states inherently.
You prefer route-based dialog management using the Navigator directly.
strengths: No native code required, pure Flutter implementation.
Global access without needing a BuildContext.
Supports custom loading widgets and configuration themes.
weaknesses: Relies on global functions rather than modern declarative state approaches.
Limited to loading indicators and dialogs.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your application or MaterialApp with the LoadingProvider.
